Transport Modes

เครนสนาม

A large crane located in container yards or terminals, used to lift, stack, and move containers or heavy cargo between storage areas and transport vehicles.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A large crane located in container yards or terminals, used to lift, stack, and move containers or heavy cargo between storage areas and transport vehicles.

Operational example

The yard crane lifted the loaded container from the truck and stacked it in the designated storage area, following terminal protocol.
